basic_info.description: Nestled atop Bernal Heights in a coveted north slope locale, this exquisite Edwardian residence has undergone a remarkable metamorphosis into a stunning 3-level home boasting every convenience for modern-day living with sweeping panoramic views from all three levels! A versatile floor plan, offering 4 bedrooms and 4 full baths, top-floor media/family room, three decks, an expansive flat backyard, and garage for one car with seamless interior access. Amenities include air conditioning, solar power, radiant heating, custom closets, a gas fireplace, high-end Thermador appliances, designer fixtures, window treatments, and ample storage space.  An excellent location, 2 blocks from Precita Park!
